title: nb-auditor: Bash is unrestricted and auditor_model is not wired to the agent
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

SPEC (Audit): the auditor is a subagent with read-only tools, and its model is `auditor_model`.

- `agents/nb-auditor.md` line 4 declares `tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob`. The limit to nb read commands is prose only.
- Line 5 hard-codes `model: sonnet`. The config value takes effect only if the calling Claude follows the skill or `/nb-audit` instruction to pass it. `nb config get` is not in the skill's `allowed-tools`.

Not verified: whether an arbitrary `auditor_model` string is usable as the Agent tool's model.
